verdict.rationale: Omnara documents mobile/dashboard access to follow agents live, send corrections, and approve actions requiring approval, with agents pausing to ask for input — directly supporting phone-based oversight while agents continue elsewhere (omnara-docs-7, omnara-docs-8, omnara-gh-3). However, community evidence raises unresolved concerns about message privacy/encryption and no independent hands-on confirmation of the approval-while-mobile workflow specifically was found. Missing for 10: hands-on/independent verification of the approve-from-phone flow in practice, detail on latency/reliability of push notifications for approvals, and resolution of community concerns about data visibility (omnara-comm-13, omnara-comm-20).
